map.每次进刀需对刀基准一致，螺距 1.5mm 对应主轴每转刀架走 1.5mm；乱扣多: Each pass needs a consistent tool-reference; pitch 1.5mm means the toolpost advances 1.5mm per spindle revolution; mismatch is usually from not lifting the half-nut on retract or encoder step loss.
map.车螺纹转速怎么定？: How to set the thread-turning speed?
map.由 vc 与直径算，小直径可高转；但需保证走刀与螺距同步，高转速时系统响应要跟得: Compute from vc and diameter; small diameters can run at high rpm; but ensure feed-to-pitch synchronization, with system response keeping up at high speed.
map.公制三角螺纹 d2 = d−0.6495P 是标准 60° 牙型近似，英制/梯形: The metric triangular-thread d2 = d−0.6495P is the standard 60° profile approximation; inch / trapezoidal threads use different coefficients and need their respective standards.
